detail.longDescription: I had doubts about # AI # LLM systems till I read the # ChatGPT feedback on my # Moodle Reports SQL plugin. "I read through the documentation. This is already unusually feature-complete for a Moodle SQL reporting plugin: SQL authoring assistance, validation, live testing, Report Builder integration, audiences, per-user filtering, charts, scheduled exports, embedding, import/export, migration, portability helpers, and some thoughtful security controls." https:// github.com/marcusgreen/report_ sql/blob/MOODLE_405_STABLE/docs/userdocs.md # EdTech # KoolAid
